lines.zh: 沙丘上，我的爪印一深一浅。
lines.en: On the dunes my paw prints run deep, then shallow.
I walk the sand crests on the night wind.
The sand is soft, and my stride stays steady.

lines.zh: 我绕着倒塌的石柱走了一圈。
lines.en: I circle the fallen pillars once.
Water cannot stop my steps.
Cobwebs slide right off me.
I pull my paw out of the sand.
In the night desert, only I remain.
My shadow is longer than the dunes.

lines.zh: 一步一步，朝你的火光走。
lines.en: Step by step, toward your torchlight.

lines.zh: 我压低身子，慢慢踱过去。
lines.en: I lower my body and pad across.
The sand sings beneath my feet.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方，风会抹平。
lines.en: The wind smooths wherever I have passed.

lines.zh: 沙漠的夜里，我的眼睛最亮。
lines.en: Desert night — my eyes are brightest.

lines.zh: 走到石柱那边，再转回来。
lines.en: I will walk to the pillars and back.
My tail sweeps across the sand.
I crouch on the dune and listen to the wind.
Still as a carved statue.
The desert night is far too quiet.
I am counting stars. Not finished yet.
The wind combs through my mane.
Sand settles on my back. Too lazy to shake.
My claws slide in gently.
Waiting for someone brave enough to approach.
My eyes are shut, but my ears still listen.
All this sand belongs to me.
I lick the sand from the corner of my mouth.

lines.zh: 白天太亮，我只在夜里来。
lines.en: Daylight is too bright. I come only at night.
Soon? Not yet.
I yawn, and the wind stops.
You are standing on my sand.
Lift your head. Let me see you.
You carry fire. I am not afraid.
Your eyes are trembling.

lines.zh: 我一直看着你，别装没看见。
lines.en: I have been watching. Don't pretend otherwise.
That armor will not stop me.

lines.zh: 你知道斯芬克斯的规矩吗？
lines.en: Do you know a sphinx's rule?
Careful, walking at night.
I smell the sweat on you.
Don't blink. I will come closer.
You hit me. Blind luck.

lines.zh: 泥身子上多一道，不算什么。
lines.en: One more mark on this clay body is nothing.
My mane is slightly ruffled.
Don't cut my face.
You dare to raise a hand to me?
It hurts, but it is far from enough.
My hide is thicker than you think.
I give half a step, then press back in.
Your hands are shaking. Go on.

lines.zh: 沙漠会替你记着这笔账。
lines.en: The desert will remember this for you.
What is that smell in your hand?
Put the food down and step back two paces.
I rarely eat. Today is an exception.

lines.zh: 沙漠里没什么可以咬的。
lines.en: There is little to bite in the desert.

lines.zh: 沙漠夜里，你晃得我眼花。
lines.en: Desert night, and you make my eyes swim.
Is it meat, or something else?

lines.zh: 别拿它逗我，我耐心有限。
lines.en: Don't tease me with it. My patience is short.
Just leave it there on the sand.
That diamond shard, give it to me.
I want one bite. Just one.
Bumping into me is like hitting stone.
I block your way, and I am wide.

lines.zh: 别推，我的爪子陷进沙里了。
lines.en: Don't push. My claws are dug into the sand.

lines.zh: 你整个人撞上我的胸口。
lines.en: You crashed into my chest.

lines.zh: 我的爪子陷进沙里，很稳。
lines.en: My claws are planted in the sand.
Touch my hide and your hand goes numb.
I turn slowly and block the way.
You slipped past my shoulder.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，沙扬起来。
lines.en: We collide and the sand flies up.

lines.zh: 我不是故意的，是你太靠前。
lines.en: I didn't mean to. You stood too close.
Another one waits behind the dune.
We circle each other in the moonlight.
You want to watch? Not appropriate.
The sand will remember our tracks.

lines.zh: 她的声音像风穿过石柱。
lines.en: Her voice is wind through the pillars.

lines.zh: 再过几夜，沙漠多一个谜。
lines.en: In a few nights, the desert gains another riddle.

lines.zh: 沙丘后面有另一行爪印。
lines.en: Another set of paw prints lies beyond the dune.

lines.zh: 夜里的沙漠，才是我的场。
lines.en: The desert at night is my arena.

lines.zh: 夜还长，我们会走到日出。
lines.en: The night is long. We walk until sunrise.

lines.zh: 沙漠的孩子，都从沙里来。
lines.en: Desert children all come from the sand.

lines.zh: 这金苹果派切片归我了。
lines.en: This golden apple pie slice is mine.

lines.zh: 这些闪亮的碎片，真好看。
lines.en: These glittering shards are lovely.

lines.zh: 我叼起箱子，放在掌心里。
lines.en: I pick up the chest and hold it in my paw.

lines.zh: 这枚指环套不上我的爪。
lines.en: This ring will not fit my claw.
I sniff it. A little statue.
A ring? It won't fit my paw.
The diamond's glitter suits me well.

lines.zh: 我把它埋进沙里，稍后来取。
lines.en: I bury it in the sand and will come back for it.

lines.zh: 你丢下的，别指望拿回去。
lines.en: You dropped it. Don't expect it back.
My paws are nimble. Watch.
You have stepped in the wrong place.
I have you locked in my sight.
Don't run. The sand will drag at your feet.
I strike first.
My paw prints have already circled you.
No one hears you in the desert.

lines.zh: 沙在拖你的脚，我看见了。
lines.en: The sand drags at your feet; I can see it.
I crouch low, ready to spring.

lines.zh: 你举盾也没用，我会绕开。
lines.en: A shield won't help. I will go around it.
It's you. Don't play dumb.
I waited the whole night.
Don't blink. This begins now.
I follow slowly. There is no hurry.
You have run off toward the pillars.

lines.zh: 爪子陷进沙里，我还是跟着。
lines.en: My claws sink in the sand, and still I follow.

lines.zh: 你撑不了多久，沙漠很热。
lines.en: You won't last long. The desert is hot.

lines.zh: 沙地上，你脚边的影子是我的。
lines.en: On the sand, the shadow at your feet is mine.
You looked back at me.
Keep backing up. A cliff lies behind you.
I have circled to the windward side.

lines.zh: 蛛网拦不住我，你的阵也不行。
lines.en: Webs can't stop me, and neither can your lines.
Your breathing is getting louder.
Step by step, I close the distance.
At night, no one comes to save you.
One swipe and the sand bursts apart.
Your legs buckle. That's slowness.
Can't lift your arms now, can you?
I swatted your shield away.
This bite lands on your shoulder.
You can't even hold your pick steady.
My claws are quicker than any blade.
You fell into the sand. Just right.
Does it hurt? That's how the desert is.

lines.zh: 再近一点，我再给你一下。
lines.en: Come closer. I'll give you another.

lines.zh: 夜里的沙漠裂开一道影。
lines.en: A shadow splits the night desert.
I walk out from behind the dune.

lines.zh: 沙滑落下来，露出我的脸。
lines.en: The sand slides away and reveals my face.
The moon lights me. You should leave.
I'm here, and the night grows longer.
Beneath the pillars, I open my eyes.

lines.zh: 沙漠的夜里，我问你一个问题。
lines.en: On a desert night, I ask you a riddle.

lines.zh: 这片沙欢迎我，不欢迎你。
lines.en: This sand welcomes me. Not you.
One low growl, and the dunes quiver.
Another night, another riddle.

lines.zh: 火舌舔过来，我眼都不眨。
lines.en: Flames lick at me and I don't even blink.

lines.zh: 从高处落下？沙地会接住我。
lines.en: A fall? The sand catches me.

lines.zh: 水底我也走得稳，不会呛。
lines.en: I walk steadily underwater without choking.

lines.zh: 炸响惊了沙，却伤不到我。
lines.en: The blast startles the sand, not me.

lines.zh: 箭一碰到我，就软了下去。
lines.en: Arrows go limp the moment they touch me.

lines.zh: 咒语绕着我转，进不了身。
lines.en: The spell circles me and cannot get in.

lines.zh: 饿得发慌，沙漠什么也不给。
lines.en: Hunger gnaws at me. The desert gives nothing.
Lightning strikes, and I stand through it.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有沙，脚下空空的。
lines.en: No sand in the void. Nothing beneath my feet.
